name: GALLERY MoMo Projects
about_text: GALLERY MoMo is a contemporary art gallery in Tokyo, established in 2003 in Roppongi. In 2008 it opened a larger space in Ryogoku, and in 2013 the original Roppongi space was reopened as GALLERY MoMo Projects, focused on discovering young Japanese and international artists and curators. The gallery mainly represents Japanese artists born in the 1970s and 1980s, whose work reflects contemporary states of mind through personal styles, while also seeking connections to a global artistic context. Its stated mission is to introduce international artists with distinctive concepts to Japanese audiences, and to bring Japanese artists to audiences abroad.
hours_text: Ryogoku: Tuesday–Saturday 11:00am–7:00pm; Roppongi Projects: Tuesday–Saturday 12:00pm–7:00pm. Closed Sunday, Monday, and national holidays.
